 How much does Adam Kersey’s card count vary between matches?
 Of the 20 matches analysed, 10.0% ended with 0–2 cards, 50.0% with 3–5 and 40.0% with 6 or more.
 How do Adam Kersey’s latest ten matches compare within this sample?
 The ten most recent matches in the sample average 4.30 cards, compared with 4.70 across all 20 matches analysed.

 Across the 20 matches analysed, home teams average 2.25 yellow cards and away teams 2.20. This describes the sample; it does not, on its own, establish favouritism.
